system.attitude: If your group faced a problem because you wanted to show off your expertise or knowledge, gain growth.
system.description:
When you excel, you want everyone to know it.

  • Attributes: Add +1 to Insight and +1 to any other attribute

  • Skills: Add +1 to Study or Operate.

  • Bonds: When you select bonds in the next step, at least one must be a rivalry.

  • Drive: When you succeed at a Skill Test of Difficulty 3 or higher, regain 1 Spirit.

  • Exhaustion: Uncertainty fills you when you when success eludes you. When you become exhausted, add +1 to Threat if you choose any exhaustion other than Confused.

  • Attitude: If your group faced a problem because you wanted to show off your expertise or knowledge, gain growth.
